# Example

## `...sqrt(sqrt(sqrt(x)))`

```python
from math import sqrt

value = 2
for i in range(10):
    value = sqrt(value)
    print(value)

"""
1.4142135623730951
1.189207115002721
1.0905077326652577
1.0442737824274138
1.0218971486541166
1.0108892860517005
1.0054299011128027
1.0027112750502025
1.0013547198921082
1.0006771306930664
"""
```

